results.title: Supreme Court Questions Jharkhand Police Chief Appointment Rules, Seeks Response From DGP Tadasha Mishra
results.description: The Supreme Court on Thursday indicated that Jharkhand’s framework for selecting its police chief directly conflicts with established judicial precedent, prompting the state administration to inform the bench that it will reconsider the contested measures. results.title: Rubio visits Portugal, praising 'great ally', looking to build deeper ties
results.description: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio visited Portugal during his NATO allies tour, thanking Lisbon for supporting US operations through the strategically important Lajes Field air base while discussing defence cooperation and transatlantic relations.
